findings.statement: In v1, rice and salmon are observed as separate items, with a hand touching the rice mound and another hand near a salmon slice.
In v3, a person shapes rice while separately handling a salmon slice and moves that salmon slice off-screen.
In v2, rice is pressed onto a salmon slice and a finished salmon nigiri is held, showing assembly and completion evidence within that clip.
In v4, an orange item is observed resting on a mound of white rice while a cloth and chopsticks are manipulated nearby.
In v4, a mound of white rice and a separate orange slice are also observed on the board during cloth and chopstick handling.
